New book

自由エネルギー原理を哲学する

Forthcoming November 2026 · in Japanese

自由エネルギー原理を哲学する

Philosophizing the Free Energy Principle: Body, Consciousness, and AI

From the “predictive mind” to “predictive life.” Can the free energy principle become a theory that understands life and mind in a unified way? Drawing on empirical findings and philosophical argument, the book examines the core of the principle and how far it reaches.

  • Sole author
  • Keisō Shobō
  • 336 pages
  • ISBN 978-4-326-15505-7
